temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices that Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, Gary declines because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was a dedicated, hardworking friend, but he was becoming concerned that Gary's habits might be harmful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Ethan's concern is confirmed: Gary is heavily overcommitted to hospital work and is unwilling or unable to step away even for a short retreat.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is at risk of burnout and that his work obligations are preventing him from taking care of his health.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to intervene supportively, encourage Gary to rest, and find another way to help him address his health.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says the situation is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary's overwork was primarily caused by hospital demands, though he still worried that Gary needed rest and support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Gary's restlessness and avoidance shift Ethan's belief from a work-only explanation toward suspicion that Gary is dealing with deeper personal or emotional issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes there is more to Gary's overworking than professional obligations, and that Gary may be hiding a burden because he does not want to impose on others.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to gently confront Gary and offer nonjudgmental support so Gary feels safe opening up.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the confrontation, Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Gary accepts Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspected Gary was dealing with something beyond ordinary work stress and was reluctant to share it because he did not want to burden others.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Gary's disclosure replaces Ethan's suspicion with concrete understanding: Gary is facing both professional pressures and personal challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is driven by a combination of new-department pressure and personal difficulties, and that Gary is now willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and find a healthier work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports that things are better, he is less overwhelmed, and he even had time for a movie last weekend. Ethan sees Gary making efforts to change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary had begun addressing his balance issues and had accepted help, but he knew Gary might still face ongoing challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Gary's reports and visible efforts provide evidence that his situation is improving and that Ethan's support is helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is making genuine progress toward better balance and that continued encouragement will help sustain that progress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to continue regular check-ins, offer encouragement, and remain available to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels much more in control now. Ethan decides it is time to step back while letting Gary know he is always available.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was improving but might still benefit from ongoing support and periodic check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Gary's sustained adjustment and expressed sense of control show that he can now manage his work-life balance more independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is capable of maintaining a healthier balance on his own and no longer needs active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ethan intends to step back from active support while remaining available if Gary ever needs him.
